result.title: PCXR-Copilot: Device-aware pediatric chest radiographic analysis with segmentation, suppression, and edema-related cues
result.summary: Patients admitted to pediatric ICU and cardiac ICU often require intensive perioperative support and frequent chest radiography to monitor support devices, extravascular lung water, and body-wall edema. Radiographic interpretation and analysis is often difficult due to superimposed anatomic and iatrogenic structures that obscure clinically relevant signals. While deep learning can provide decision support, translation to pediatric radiographs is still limited by high device burden and scarcity of pediatric datasets with clinically grounded device annotations. To address this gap, we first introduce PediaDeviceSeg-1K, a curated dataset of 1,000 anterior-posterior radiographs of pediatric CICU patients with clinically grounded, fine-grained annotations of common ICU devices. To our best knowledge, this is the first publicly available pediatric CICU CXR resource with clinically grounded device annotations for device-focused benchmarking. Building on PediaDeviceSeg-1K, we further present PCXR-Copilot, a device-aware pipeline that outputs lung and device masks, optional device-suppressed views, and edema-related visualization maps and scalar indices. The full pipeline has been integrated and runs in real time within the TWIST platform at Boston Children's Hospital, demonstrating feasibility for real-world clinical deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作发布 PediaDeviceSeg-1K——1,000 张儿科 CICU 正位胸片、含临床依据的细粒度器械标注数据集，并构建 PCXR-Copilot 流水线，输出肺与器械掩膜、可选的器械抑制视图以及水肿相关可视化图和标量指标，已在医院平台实时运行。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「device-aware 器械抑制视图」可能为 LVR 中过滤干扰性视觉证据、按区域筛选视觉输入提供线索，可供核查；但本文是临床影像流水线，未涉及推理期状态生成或答案对视觉内容的依赖，关联偏间接。
